subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who believes in the existence of God
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Theist"** refers to a person who believes in the existence of a god or gods. (ईश्वरवादी)

 
 
• **Example: **John is a** theist** who attends church services every Sunday.
 
 
 
• **"Atheist"** refers to a person who does not believe in the existence of any god or gods. (नास्तिक)
 
 
• **Example: **Mary identifies as an **atheist **and does not participate in religious activities.
 
 

Therefore, the correct one word substitution for the given phrase is** "Theist."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fatalist **(नियति वादी): A person who believes that all events are predetermined and therefore inevitable.

 
 
• **Example:** As a **fatalist,** she believes that everything happens for a reason and cannot be changed.
 
 
 
• **Atheist **(नास्तिक): A person who does not believe in the existence of any god or gods.
 
 
• **Example: **Mary identifies as an **atheist** and does not participate in religious activities.
 
 
 
• **Protagonist** (मुख्य पात्र): The main character in a drama, movie, novel, or other narrative.
 
 
• **Example:** The **protagonist** of the novel faces numerous challenges throughout the story.
